title: Looking for a short-term micro-loan in USDT for trading (2-week repayment)
author: ComfortableEqual6376
selftext:
Hey everyone, I am going to be completely honest here because I do not want to waste anyone's time.  
Right now I do not have capital available, and I am looking for a short-term micro-loan of $50 in USDT on Binance to fund my trading executions.  
I know asking for funds on Reddit carries trust risk, especially with trading. I am not asking for a handout and my commitment is to repay the full $50 in 2 weeks (by December 4, 2026), along with a small bonus and full transparency on how it is managed. I can also help with chart markup, research, or data entry in return if needed.  
Even if you cannot lend anything, I would appreciate any realistic advice on trading with small capital and strict risk management. Thanks for reading.
